speaker: A
name: Alex
text: When did you start using social media?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: I think it was primary school. Our teacher set up a class group on QQ — it's a Chinese app, kind of like WeChat — and all the students had to join it to get notices, because the teacher would sometimes send announcements there. So I've basically been on social media since I was a pupil.
